# telnyx_whatsapp_business_account_phone_numbers (Data Source)

The phone numbers registered with one WhatsApp Business Account (WABA), with their WhatsApp status, quality rating and calling setting.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object whose items are listed.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `whatsapp_business_account_phone_numbers` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--whatsapp_business_account_phone_numbers))

<a id="nestedatt--whatsapp_business_account_phone_numbers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `whatsapp_business_account_phone_numbers`

Read-Only:

- `calling_enabled` (Boolean)
- `coexistence_state` (String) Current lifecycle state for a coexistence number. This is null for a standard Cloud API number.
- `created_at` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `is_on_biz_app` (Boolean) Indicates whether the number is connected to both the WhatsApp Business app and Cloud API through WhatsApp Coexistence.
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number in E164 format
- `phone_number_id` (String) Whatsapp phone number ID
- `quality_rating` (String) Whatsapp quality rating
- `record_type` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `sync_deadline` (String) Deadline for initiating the current coexistence synchronization cycle. This is null when no deadline applies.
- `sync_progress` (Attributes) Synchronization progress. This object is returned only while a coexistence number is synchronizing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--whatsapp_business_account_phone_numbers--sync_progress))
- `user_id` (String) User ID
- `waba_id` (String) WABA ID of Whatsapp business account

<a id="nestedatt--whatsapp_business_account_phone_numbers--sync_progress"></a>
### Nested Schema for `whatsapp_business_account_phone_numbers.sync_progress`

Read-Only:

- `contacts_status` (String)
- `history_chunk_order` (Number)
- `history_phase` (Number)
- `history_progress` (Number)
- `history_status` (String)
